subject: Reservation cadence & acceptance checkpoints — MAP runway and GPU pool sizing
messages:
From: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@ceruleanbio.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:12:00Z
Subject: Initial MAP draft & lead time questions

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood’s latency and the private deployment options. Attached is a first-pass MAP (Cerulean_MAP_v1.xlsx) with a proposed evaluation window and acceptance criteria. A couple of quick Qs we couldn't parse from the demo: 

- For Private (on-prem/VPC) deployments, what are realistic procurement and setup lead times for a Dedicated GPU pool (H100-class)?
- If we commit to a reserved tranche, how do you recommend staging capacity (pilot vs prod) so we don’t overprovision?

We'd like to sync with procurement and infra next week to align timelines. Can you point us to a sample acceptance checklist and a short cadence you recommend for the MAP?

Appreciate it —
Alex
Head of Platform Eng, Cerulean Bio
Attachments: Cerulean_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@ceruleanbio.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial MAP draft & lead time questions

Alex —

Great to get the MAP. High level answers up front: 

- Dedicated (Reserved) H100 pool: procurement to production is typically 8–12 weeks when using cloud partners + reserved capacity path; for Private/VPC (customer-managed), plan 10–16 weeks depending on customer infra and network approvals.
- Staging approach: we recommend a two-tranche model — 10–20% pilot tranche to validate performance/ev-sets and the remainder staged across 2–3 weekly activations tied to acceptance gates.

I'll attach a lightweight acceptance checklist and a sample cadence. Neha and Rishi — looping you in to propose sizing guidance and an adjusted MAP cadence for Cerulean (I skimmed the workbook).

Proposed next step: 30-min call with Cerulean infra + procurement Tues 11/3 or Wed 11/4. Alex — which slot works?

Thanks,
Mina
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial MAP draft & lead time questions

Thanks Mina — Alex / Cerulean: a couple of concrete sizing notes from infra/ops perspective: 

- For model mix you described (instruction-tuned LLM + chat + embedding heavy retrieval), starting pool recommendation: 6 x H100 (80GB) for pilot (concurrent users ~100, token profile P95 ~1.5k) then expand to 20–24 H100 for steady-state production depending on latency SLOs and batching.
- If you plan quantization and smaller sequence lengths for embeddings-heavy flows, we can reduce prod to ~16 H100 equivalent using mixed-precision and batching.

MAP cadence suggestion (tight):
- Week 0: Contract signature + kick-off (define SOW, security Qs)
- Week 1–3: Pilot provisioning & smoke tests (10–20% tranche)
- Week 4–8: Evaluation runs, performance tuning, acceptance test suite
- Week 9–12+: Full tranche activation and production cutover

I'll draft a Sizing tab for the MAP workbook with these numbers. Lauren — can you attach the acceptance checklist and the 'private-deploy runbook' so I can link it into the MAP?

-Neha
Infra & Onboarding, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@ceruleanbio.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@ceruleanbio.com
Date: 2026-11-02T13:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial MAP draft & lead time questions

Mina / Neha — thanks. That sizing range is helpful and the tranche plan looks reasonable. Two procurement constraints to flag: 

1) Cerulean requires a signed SOW + PO before we can begin any network provisioning with our VPC team. That typically adds a 7–10 business day internal procurement lead time.
2) We have a compliance window for SOC2 evidence review that must complete prior to prod activation (they want log retention and audit hook details).

We can do Tue 11/3 11:00–11:30 PT for the sync (I’ll invite infra + procurement). Please send the acceptance checklist and the SOW template if available so our legal can review alongside procurement.

Best,
Alex
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@ceruleanbio.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T01:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial MAP draft & lead time questions

Alex — confirmed for Tue 11/3 11:00 PT. Attached: scope_of_work_v2.pdf (SOW template) and a one-page acceptance checklist. Quick clarifications to help procurement: 

- SOW includes a staged activation clause: initial pilot invoice on activation of pilot tranche, remainder invoiced on production cutover.
- For Private/VPC, network requirements are limited to (1) egress rules for control-plane, (2) SSH/Jumphost for on-prem install windows (if applicable). We'll specify exact IPs in the SOW.

Action items going into the sync: 
- Cerulean: confirm PO timelines + compliance point of contact (SOC2 owner)
- Redwood: finalize pilot size (Neha to propose numbers in updated MAP workbook), provide acceptance checklist and secure audit/logging example config for SOC2 review (Rishi).

See you Tuesday.

-Mina
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: scope_of_work_v2.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@ceruleanbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Reservation cadence & acceptance checkpoints — MAP runway and GPU pool sizing

Quick follow-up after the 11/3 sync — notes and a low-risk hedge for Cerulean’s MAP: 

- Pilot tranche: 6 H100 for 3 weeks of continuous evaluation with a defined acceptance checklist (latency P95 < 180ms for gen workloads, end-to-end through retrieval pipeline).
- Prod ramp: staggered activations at +2 weeks and +6 weeks after pilot sign-off (add 8 and 6 H100 respectively) to reach ~20 H100 steady-state.
- Contingency: autoscaling burst pool (cloud-backed) available as a short-term hedge for sudden spikes — we can enable until the private pool is fully validated.

I attached a short audit config snippet and a template SOC2 evidence checklist link in the MAP Drive folder so Cerulean’s compliance team can validate before acceptance. Ben — want to confirm commercial cadence (pilot invoice vs production billing) and whether the staged clause in scope_of_work_v2.pdf needs any edits for billing triggers.

-Rishi
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
